jobs.description:
Hinter jeder erfolgreichen Prüfung, Zertifizierung und Inspektion steht ein starkes Team in unseren Service Funktionen. Ob HR, IT, Finance, Marketing, Controlling, Einkauf, Facility Management, unsere Shared Service Center, QHSE, Legal, Corporate Development oder Corporate Communication – sie alle tragen dazu bei, dass unsere operativen Einheiten weltweit Höchstleistungen erbringen können.

Job Description

- As a SAP Developer UI5 Fiori BTP CAP (w/m/d), you design, develop, and enhance modern SAP applications using SAP UI5/Fiori, SAP Business Technology Platform, and the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model.
- You take technical ownership of application development projects and ensure that solutions are secure, maintainable, and built to a high quality standard.
- Business requirements are translated into scalable technical concepts and solution designs that support sustainable application architecture.
- You develop and maintain SAP UI5/Fiori applications, OData services, APIs, and integrations with SAP and non-SAP systems, while contributing to Clean Core and cloud-based architecture principles .
- Working closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and external partners, you help define development standards, testing approaches, and quality assurance measures while supporting knowledge transfer within the team.

Experience und Further Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, or a comparable qualification
- At least 5 years of professional experience in SAP application development
- Strong hands-on experience with SAP UI5, SAP Fiori, HTML5, JavaScript, XML, CSS, JSON, and OData services, as well as practical experience with SAP Business Technology Platform and SAP Cloud Application Programming Model
- Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and agile development methods
- Fluent English skills in writing and speaking at B2 to C1 level. German language skills are an advantage, along with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders in an international environment

You’ve built AI.
Now you want to build what’s next.

WAIYS is a Norwegian-German tech company on a mission to simplify AI adoption in the real estate industry.

We combine advanced AI software, robust infrastructure, and deep domain expertise to build modular AI SaaS for real estate investors, developers, and managers. Our solutions range from chatbots to advanced analytics to full agentic automations.

Your Role

This position is for experienced AI engineers who want more than just clean code. You want a meaningful impact.

You will:

- Deliver AI projects that grow our AI business unit
- Build, integrate, and evaluate production-grade AI/ML models and demonstrators
- Track and translate cutting-edge AI research into working solutions
- Shape and protect our AI-related intellectual property
- Design scalable APIs, data pipelines, and backend infrastructure
- Automate builds, tests, and deployments (CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code)
- Uphold rigorous testing, documentation, and security standards
- Work cross-functionally to embed AI into our product portfolio

What You Bring:

- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in applied AI, delivering real-world solutions
- Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ (OOP, clean code, design patterns)
- Deep knowledge of ML algorithms, data preprocessing, and at least one major framework (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Practical experience with MLOps: web servers (e.g. Apache, Nginx), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and version control systems (Git)
- Fluent English and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly
- German skills are helpful for local collaboration
- An analytical, independent mindset – and curiosity for sustainable, future-ready tech

What You’ll Find at WAIYS:

We’re an independent startup with room to grow, build, and shape from the ground up. You’ll work in a motivated team that values clarity, collaboration, and meaningful innovation.

We offer:

- Hybrid-remote work model (within Norway or Germany)
- 30 vacation days
- Flexible working hours
- Company pension scheme
- Employee benefits and perks
- A highly innovative field of activity
- An open company culture that values ideas over titles

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%

Grundkenntnisse: TensorFlow Framework, Programmbibliothek PyTorch
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Programmiersprache C++, MLOps-Tools, Objektorientierte Programmierung (OO-Programmierung), Programmiersprache Python, Machine Learning

Solution Sales Manager (f/m/d) Finance and Spend Mgmt - Consumer Industries

Date: 07/17/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll do

As the manager of our Finance & Spend Management sales team for Consumer customers, you will be part of the Finance & Spend Management Leadership team, reporting to the Head of Finance & Spend Management Germany. You will be responsible for building and leading a team that sells SAP’s Finance and Procurement solutions as well as Cloud ERP in our Consumer industry customer segment.
The main success criteria are the achievement of the quarterly net booking targets and the continuous solution adoption to ensure our customer’s success.
Furthermore, the following tasks are a core component of this management function:

- Building effective relationships with executives at customer and partner organizations to expand our Services business and secure deal closures within the quarter
- Supporting each sales team member to ensure expected quarterly and annual sales objectives are met.
- Facilitating individual growth and development of sales team, setting objectives, performance standards and priorities, coaching and acting as role model on sales approaches.
- Develop demand generation activities for Finance, Procurement and Cloud ERP in the space of Consumer industry business to ensure a sufficient pipeline coverage across the entire Finance & Spend portfolio.
- Consequent pipeline management and forecasting to secure the quarterly bookings and adoption targets.
- Building and maintaining effective relationships across industry, the procurement and finance community, internal VAT (Virtual Account Team), development and support organizations, as well as other internal stakeholders, involving them on the early stages of sales cycle to drive expected revenue and customer satisfaction results.
- Effectively managing remote resources, dedicating quality time and leveraging company’s resources.

What you bring

- Distinctive network within the Consumer industry customer base, Market Unit SAP Germany, the SAP partner ecosystem and the corresponding SAP solution portfolio areas. Network within the SAP Germany Sector Consumer Industries is a plus.
- Pronounced teambuilding skills and ability to lead teams to high performance
- Bachelor´s Degree in Business Administration or comparable course of studies. Master’s Degree or comparable Degree (e.g. Diploma) would be beneficial.
- Strong diplomatic and political skills
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken (min. C1 level)

Work Experience

- 5+ years of experience in SAP solutions and cloud sales, preferably in Solutions Sales Executive and Industry Account Executive roles
- Experience in sales leadership and personnel responsibility is a plus
- Experience in selling ERP or Finance and Procurement systems is a strong advantage.
- Strong understanding of SAP Finance and Spend solution portfolio
- Reliable SAP ecosystem relationships and strong partner led mentality
- Proven abilities on managing highly complex contract negotiations and applying risk-mitigation strategies to customer escalations
- Experience working in virtual teams in a highly competitive and fast-paced environment
- Sound and verifiable experience in building C-level relationships

Meet the Team

Within the Finance & Spend Management organization, we support well-known customers across all industries in Germany to drive their digital transformation of finance and spend processes across all business units. We are uniquely positioned to address the challenges of CFOs and CPOs, helping our customers enhance their bottom line through our comprehensive, end-to-end solution portfolio. By executing our AI-first and Suite-first strategy, we will not only achieve our ambitious financial targets but also drive innovation and customer success.

You will be responsible for our portfolio across the SAP Ariba, SAP Fieldglass, the Office of the CFO (oCFO), Working Capital Management (Taulia), and SAP Cloud ERP Finance solutions.

As a Sales Manager (f/m/d) you will lead one of our four German Sales Teams. We are looking for a true leader with a strong sales background and who has demonstrated business acumen in previous roles. As people manager, you will be responsible for supporting the success of not only your direct reports, but the success of all employees within the larger team. You are a part of it by closely working with the extended German Finance & Spend Management Team as well as by helping to identify development opportunities and supporting team members to achieve their goals.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

jobs.description:
The research group Assimilate Allocation and NMR (https://www.ipk-gatersleben.de/forschung/molekulare-genetik/assimilat-allokation-und-nmr) applies advanced techniques, including Magnetic Resonance Imaging, metabolomics and transcriptomics, to investigate the allocation and distribution of assimilates and metabolites in plants, with a particular focus on seeds. Within the framework of a DFG-funded project, we will use non-invasive approaches to investigate the “hidden” architecture of barley grains in relation to storage compound accumulation and to identify and validate associated genetic loci and candidate genes.

Your tasks:

- identification and quantification of previously unexplored traits of inner grain structure in barley grown under low and high N fertilization using the MRI-Seed-Wizard tool (doi.org/10.1093/jxb/erae408)
- identification of QTLs controlling traits, related to the inner structure and storage accumulation of barley grains
- identification of putative candidate genes underlying the identified QTLs
- validation and selection of favorable alleles at the candidate genes responsible for improvement of grain size and inner structure

Your qualifications and skills:

- You hold a MSc degree (or equivalent) in biology, biochemistry, crop science or a related field.
- Practical experience in working with large plant populations and GWAS analysis is desired.
- You have proficiency in data analysis and statistical software packages.

You fit to us:

- if you have a strong scientific curiosity and motivation.
- if you are able to conduct independent scientific research and collaborate in an interdisciplinary research environment.
- if you have solid oral and written English skills.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join our Global Compliance & Integrity Internal Investigations team and help drive investigation excellence. As a Compliance & Integrity Manager, you will lead internal investigations, leverage data and AI to strengthen compliance outcomes, and collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to foster a culture of integrity and accountability.
This position has a hybrid setup approximately 2 - 3 days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will lead or support internal investigations into potential violations of the Code of Conduct, company policies, compliance requirements, or applicable laws by planning and executing investigation strategies, conducting witness interviews, collecting evidence, analyzing facts, and preparing investigation reports.
- Based on your findings, you will develop objective conclusions and recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to address identified risks, control weaknesses, and underlying root causes.
- You will drive the continuous improvement of investigation methodologies, governance frameworks, reporting standards, processes, templates, and training materials to strengthen investigation quality and effectiveness.
- By leveraging data analytics and reporting tools, you will identify trends, emerging risks, and root causes while developing dashboards, KPIs, and management reports that increase transparency around case handling and remediation outcomes.
- You will identify and implement responsible AI-enabled solutions that enhance investigation efficiency, risk detection, knowledge management, and decision-making.
- Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you will ensure investigations are conducted in accordance with legal, regulatory, and company requirements while fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, procedural fairness, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

- Master's degree or equivalent in Law, Compliance, Business Administration, Audit, Forensics, Data Analytics, or a related field
- Relevant experience in compliance, internal investigations, legal, audit, risk management, forensic review, operational excellence, or data-driven compliance functions
- Experience conducting or supporting sensitive investigations, including interviews, evidence review, root-cause analysis, reporting, and remediation recommendations
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex information and data into practical insights and recommendations
- Interest in data analytics, AI-enabled solutions, automation, and continuous improvement
- Strong project management and stakeholder management skills in a global environment
- Excellent communication skills, sound judgment, discretion, and high ethical standards
- Fluency in English; German is a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
WHY BOEHRINGER INGELHEIM?
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

jobs.description:
Join the Molecular Plant Nutrition (https://www.ipk-gatersleben.de/forschung/physiologie-und-zellbiologie/molekulare-pflanzenernaehrung) research group at the IPK in frame of the DFG-ISF joint project “UNLOCK”. Our research focuses on deciphering the nutrient-sensing mechanisms that regulate root development, nutrient uptake, and nutrient allocation

PhD Research Topic: Uncovering novel molecular players for nitrogen acquisition with a multi-targeted CRISPR approach

Objectives: Exploit the power of gene editing at the transcriptome scale to identify genes that regulate root system architecture and uptake mechanisms for efficient nitrogen capture. The project combines large-scale CRISPR library generation – using the Multi-Knock system to target multiple gene family members – with multi-level root phenotyping, gene expression pattern analysis, RNA sequencing, and nitrogen uptake assays. 

Your tasks:

- Phenotype the root system architecture and morphology of CRISPR/Cas9 mutants generated by our project partner using the Multi-Knock system.
- Explore the tissue- and cell type-specific expression patterns of prioritized high-impact genes and discover their functional hierarchy within nitrogen-responsive gene regulatory networks with transcriptomics and reverse genetics approaches.
- Establish how the newly identified genes regulate nitrogen uptake and nitrogen-dependent root development.

Your qualifications and skills:

- You hold a MSc degree (or equivalent) in biology, biochemistry, plant science or a related field.
- Practical experience with cultivating plants under sterile conditions is required.
- Practical experience in plant genotyping, gene cloning and genome editing is strongly desirable.

You fit to us:

- if you are fascinated by plant nutrition and plant development and have a strong interest in molecular biology, phenotyping and microscopy.
- if you have a strong scientific curiosity and motivation.

jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Pflanzen- genetik und Kulturpflanzen- forschung (IPK)
jobs.description:
Join the Resources Genetics and Reproduction (https://www.ipk-gatersleben.de/forschung/genbank/ressourcengenetik-und-reproduktion) group at the IPK in the frame of the collaborative BMFTR-funded project “MZF: Twin-3”. Our team, led by Dr. Anna Backhaus, explores how plant genetic diversity can be safeguarded, regenerated and explored for the benefit of society and nature. 

Postdoctoral Research Topic: Genebank phenomics and genomics for future barley conservation and use.

Objectives: Use state-of-the-art "digital twin" resources to explore the possibilities of seed optical and multispectral imaging in active genebank management. The aim is to explore how the latest developments in seed phenomics and big data analysis can be leveraged in a genebank setting. Each seed in our collection needs to be selected for viability, seed health, and genotype sorted. Combining state of the art genomic with phenomic data will aid more precise collection management and open the door to novel user access to the collection.

Your tasks:

- Manage field trials and associated phenotypic data collection
- Lead the develop of novel high-throughput phenotyping approaches for seeds
- Analyze independently large data sets from diverse sources
- Generate new biological insights in the field of barley genetics
- Develop and publish your own research ideas

Your qualifications and skills:

- You hold a PhD in a relevant science (plant biology, genomics, phenomics).
- You have a theoretical background in phenomics and/or genomics.
- You are experienced with data analysis tasks, ideally in the field of image analysis.
- You have an affinity to command-line based bioinformatic data analysis.
- You enjoy working in and coordinating with a diverse team of colleagues.

You fit to us:

- if you are passionate about biology, especially plant diversity.
- if you are curious, self-motivated and -organized.

- if you have solid oral and written English skills.

We offer you:

jobs.occupation: Turbine Heat Transfer Design Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join a dynamic engineering product development team focused on industrial gas turbines for power generation! Each day, you will engage in both independent and collaborative work, tackling various engine component design projects, improvements, and technical challenges. Your role will involve leveraging cutting-edge design and analysis tools while collaborating with global resources to enhance technology. You will continuously learn through hands-on tasks, innovative thinking, and specialized courses, all while sharing ideas and results with colleagues and presenting to internal customers and stakeholders.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Contribute to the design of turbine hot gas path components, delivering critical thermal analyses and designs that achieve top-tier performance in efficiency, component life, robustness, and manufacturability
* Enhance the tools landscape by improving classical heat transfer tools, tool chains, and automated workflows, identifying opportunities for AI/ML integration and providing follow-on support
* Advance Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT) 3D thermal design methodologies for new engines and upgrades, exploring new implementation approaches and methodologies
* Play a vital role in engine and component testing, validating designs and analyses by preparing test predictions and conducting post-test data reduction and analyses

What You Bring

* University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related field with a focus on thermo-fluid sciences
* Several years of industrial experience in turbomachinery, thermal design of turbine hot gas path components, fluid systems, or comparable applications
* Strong understanding of heat transfer principles and conjugate heat transfer (CHT)
* More than five years of hands-on experience with FEA, CFD, and CAD tools
* Proficiency in computational methods and programming languages such as APDL and Python
* Excellent communication skills, business-fluent English & German

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Your new role
• You own the end‑to‑end IT delivery for the Sales & Remarketing domain, ensuring stable and scalable operation as well as continuous evolution of all customer‑facing platforms, including CMS, websites, and lead management systems
• You act as a trusted partner to Sales, Operations, and Remarketing, translating business needs into a clear and prioritized IT roadmap and ensuring reliable execution of initiatives that enable seamless digital customer acquisition and sales journeys
• You lead and develop teams across multiple applications and platforms, fostering strong ownership, collaboration, and a efficient delivery culture within a transforming environment
• You drive and steer the ongoing transformation towards Salesforce Sales Cloud, ensuring smooth transition, integration into the existing landscape, and tangible business value realization
• You ensure effective governance and delivery excellence across your area, including prioritization, resource steering, and transparent performance tracking, while balancing operational stability with continuous innovation

Your strengths
• You bring several years of experience in IT Delivery, Product, or Engineering leadership, especially in customer‑facing domains such as Sales, eCommerce, CRM, or digital platforms
• You excel in leading people through change, combining empathy and clarity to build trust, create engagement, and successfully guide teams through transformation and uncertainty
• You have a strong understanding of the current landscapes around CMS, websites, and Online Retail solutions and are experienced in developing Salesforce projects
• You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to align business and IT, challenge constructively, and drive decisions with a clear focus on outcomes and customer value
• You combine a structured and analytical mindset with a pragmatic, hands‑on approach and communicate confidently in English and German in both technical and business contexts
